Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class SarirAtmosphericAssay

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.SarirAtmosphericAssay
public final class SarirAtmosphericAssay extends Object
Constrained pseudo-component input factory for the public Sarir refinery TBP reference.

The source publishes cumulative liquid-volume TBP evidence, whole-crude density, and whole-crude average molar mass, but does not publish density or molar mass for each boiling interval. This factory therefore derives cut yields and boundaries only from SarirAtmosphericReference and requires callers to supply the missing per-cut property profiles. It does not silently synthesize light-end composition or heavy-end properties.

Supplied profiles must reproduce the reported 841.5 kg/m3 whole-crude density within 1.0 kg/m3 and the reported 0.2447 kg/mol number-average molar mass within 0.001 kg/mol. These are model-consistency gates, not estimates of source uncertainty. The first 7.44 liquid vol% cut retains only the published 70 degrees Celsius upper boundary; the final 16.30 liquid vol% cut retains only the published 550 degrees Celsius lower boundary.

    • calculateBulkSpecificGravity

      public static double calculateBulkSpecificGravity(double[] cutSpecificGravity)
      Calculate bulk density-correlation input from a cut specific-gravity profile.

      Because the source yields are on a liquid-volume basis, the bulk value is the volume-weighted arithmetic mean of the cut specific gravities.

      Parameters:
      cutSpecificGravity - dimensionless specific gravity for each source-derived cut
      Returns:
      volume-weighted bulk specific gravity

    • calculateBulkMolarMassKgPerMol

      public static double calculateBulkMolarMassKgPerMol(double[] cutSpecificGravity, double[] cutMolarMassKgPerMol)
      Calculate the modeled whole-crude number-average molar mass.

      Cut volume yields are first converted to relative masses with the supplied specific gravities. The mixture molar mass is then total mass / total moles.

      Parameters:
      cutSpecificGravity - dimensionless specific gravity for each source-derived cut
      cutMolarMassKgPerMol - molar mass for each source-derived cut, in kg/mol
      Returns:
      modeled whole-crude number-average molar mass, in kg/mol

    • create

      public static OilAssayCharacterisation create(SystemInterface system, double totalAssayMassKg, double[] cutSpecificGravity, double[] cutMolarMassKgPerMol)
      Configure a constrained Sarir assay.

      Validation completes before the attached assay is cleared, so invalid profiles do not modify existing assay data or the thermodynamic component list.

      Parameters:
      system - empty or caller-owned thermodynamic system
      totalAssayMassKg - positive total modeled assay mass, in kg
      cutSpecificGravity - dimensionless specific gravity for each source-derived cut
      cutMolarMassKgPerMol - molar mass for each source-derived cut, in kg/mol
      Returns:
      configured assay; no component has been added to system
